sign-of-the-cross.title: The Sign of the Cross
sign-of-the-cross.text: In the name of the Father of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Amen

apostles-creed.title: The Apostles' Creed
apostles-creed.text: I believe in God, the Father Almighty, Creator of heaven and earth; and in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord; who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried. He descended into hell. On the third day, He rose again; He ascended into heaven and sits at the right hand of God, the Father Almighty. From there, He will come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the Holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

our-father.title: Our Father
our-father.text: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name: Thy kingdom come: Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread: and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us. And do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.

hail-mary.title: Hail Mary
hail-mary.text: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

glory-be.title: Glory be
glory-be.text:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

fatima-decade-prayer.title: Fatima prayer
fatima-decade-prayer.text:
“O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, and lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Your Mercy”.
(Our Lady at Fatima, 13th July 1917)

hail-holy-queen.title: Hail Holy Queen
hail-holy-queen.text: Hail, holy Queen, Mother of Mercy! our life, our sweetness, and our hope! To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley, of tears. Turn, then, most gracious Advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us; and after this our exile show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus; O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

final-rosary-prayer.title: Final Rosary Prayer
final-rosary-prayer.text: “O God whose only begotten Son by His Life has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life, Grant that we beseech Thee while meditating upon these mysteries of the Most Holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may both imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise, through the same Christ our Lord Amen.”

fatima-prayer-2.title: Fatima prayer #2
fatima-prayer-2.text: “My God, I believe, I adore, I hope, and I love You. I beg pardon of You for those who do not believe, do not adore, do not hope, and do not love You.”

mystery-joyful-1.title: First Joyful Mystery — The Annunciation
mystery-joyful-1.text: The Angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will conceive and bear the Son of God.

mystery-joyful-2.title: Second Joyful Mystery — The Visitation
mystery-joyful-2.text: Mary visits Elizabeth; John the Baptist leaps in his mother’s womb.

mystery-joyful-4.title: Fourth Joyful Mystery — The Presentation
mystery-joyful-4.text: Mary and Joseph present the infant Jesus in the Temple.

mystery-joyful-5.title: Fifth Joyful Mystery — The Finding in the Temple
mystery-joyful-5.text: The child Jesus is found in the Temple, sitting among the teachers.

mystery-sorrowful-1.title: First Sorrowful Mystery — The Agony in the Garden
mystery-sorrowful-1.text: Jesus prays in Gethsemane; His soul is sorrowful even unto death.

mystery-sorrowful-2.title: Second Sorrowful Mystery — The Scourging at the Pillar
mystery-sorrowful-2.text: Jesus is bound to the pillar and scourged.

mystery-sorrowful-3.title: Third Sorrowful Mystery — The Crowning with Thorns
mystery-sorrowful-3.text: Jesus is crowned with thorns and mocked as King of the Jews.

mystery-sorrowful-4.title: Fourth Sorrowful Mystery — The Carrying of the Cross
mystery-sorrowful-4.text: Jesus carries His cross to Calvary, falling under its weight.

mystery-sorrowful-5.title: Fifth Sorrowful Mystery — The Crucifixion
mystery-sorrowful-5.text: Jesus is nailed to the cross and dies for our salvation.

mystery-glorious-1.title: First Glorious Mystery — The Resurrection
mystery-glorious-1.text: Christ rises from the dead on the third day, victorious over sin and death.

mystery-glorious-2.title: Second Glorious Mystery — The Ascension
mystery-glorious-2.text: Jesus ascends into heaven forty days after His Resurrection.

mystery-glorious-3.title: Third Glorious Mystery — The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mystery-glorious-3.text: The Holy Spirit descends upon Mary and the Apostles at Pentecost.

mystery-glorious-4.title: Fourth Glorious Mystery — The Assumption
mystery-glorious-4.text: The Blessed Virgin Mary is taken body and soul into heavenly glory.

mystery-glorious-5.title: Fifth Glorious Mystery — The Coronation
mystery-glorious-5.text: Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven and of all creation.

mystery-luminous-1.title: First Luminous Mystery — The Baptism of the Lord
mystery-luminous-1.text: Christ is baptized by John in the Jordan; the Father’s voice proclaims Him beloved Son.

mystery-luminous-2.title: Second Luminous Mystery — The Wedding at Cana
mystery-luminous-2.text: Jesus reveals His glory, turning water into wine at Mary’s request.

mystery-luminous-3.title: Third Luminous Mystery — The Proclamation of the Kingdom
mystery-luminous-3.text: Jesus calls all to repentance and faith in the Gospel of the Kingdom.

mystery-luminous-4.title: Fourth Luminous Mystery — The Transfiguration
mystery-luminous-4.text: Jesus is transfigured in glory before Peter, James, and John.

mystery-luminous-5.title: Fifth Luminous Mystery — The Institution of the Eucharist
mystery-luminous-5.text: Christ offers His Body and Blood in the Sacrament of the New Covenant.

angelus-opening.title: Angelus — opening
angelus-opening.text: The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.

angelus-response-1.title: Angelus
angelus-response-1.text: And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.

angelus-versicle-2.title: Angelus
angelus-versicle-2.text: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.

angelus-response-2.title: Angelus
angelus-response-2.text: Be it done unto me according to thy word.

angelus-versicle-3.title: Angelus
angelus-versicle-3.text: And the Word was made Flesh.

angelus-closing.title: Angelus — closing
angelus-closing.text: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
